description_en: A navigable map of the British Isles, from the Burren to the Firth of Forth. Six champions stand in the wind, each in their own corner of the celtic world.
description_ga: Léarscáil nasctha de na hOileáin Breatnacha, ón mBoirinn go Foirth an Abhann. Sé laoch ar sé choirnéal den domhan Ceilteach.

diegetic_zones.tooltip_en: The pine ridge above Glencree. The wind smells of heather and wet stone.
diegetic_zones.tooltip_ga: Droim na gcrann os cionn Ghleann Crí. Bolann an ghaoth fraoch agus cloch fhliuch.

diegetic_zones.tooltip_en: The fog-bound jetty at Port Erin. The harbour-light is on, the way home open.
diegetic_zones.tooltip_ga: An caladh ceo-bhainte i gCaladh Eireann. Tá an solas ar lasadh, an bealach abhaile oscailte.

diegetic_zones.tooltip_en: The horse-gate at Pembroke, the wind blowing the gorse. You can hear hooves on the hillside.
diegetic_zones.tooltip_ga: Geata na gcapall i bPenfro, an ghaoth ag séideadh an ghoirt. Cloistear crúba ar an sliabh.

diegetic_zones.tooltip_en: The well-spring of Sláine, where the waters run hot. The forge-hammer rings down the valley.
diegetic_zones.tooltip_ga: Tobar Sláine, a ritheann na huiscí te. Bualann an casúr anuas an gleann.

diegetic_zones.tooltip_en: The hazel-wood above the Liffey. The boar-tracks are fresh, the leaves still tremble.
diegetic_zones.tooltip_ga: Coill an choll os cionn na Life. Tá rianta an mhuc ar an talamh, tá na duilleoga ag crith.

diegetic_zones.tooltip_en: The rock of Carrigaphooca, where the smoke of the exile rises. You can hear oars on the tide.
diegetic_zones.tooltip_ga: Carraig an Phúca, a éiríonn deatach an deoraí. Cloistear rámhaí ar an taoide.
